Export.zv: IRIS for UNIX (Ubuntu Server LTS for ARM64 Containers) 2026.1 (Build 234U)

Class.name: %IPM.General.ModuleSummary
Class.Description: Builds the summary that the show command prints for one installed module.

Method.name: Show
Method.Description: Writes the summary of moduleName, an installed module in the current namespace. moduleName may be the module's Name or ExternalName, in any case.

Method.name: GetDirectDependents
Method.Description: Returns the installed modules that declare moduleName as an unscoped dependency, as {"name":..., "version":...} objects.
Method.Implementation: set dependents = [] set query = "SELECT ModuleItem->Name AS Name, ModuleItem->VersionString AS VersionString FROM %IPM_Storage.ModuleItem_Dependencies WHERE Dependencies_Name = ? AND (Dependencies_Scope IS NULL OR Dependencies_Scope = '') ORDER BY ModuleItem->Name" set rs = ##class(%SQL.Statement).%ExecDirect(, query, moduleName) $$$ThrowSQLIfError(rs.%SQLCODE, rs.%Message) while rs.%Next(.sc) { $$$ThrowOnError(sc) do dependents.%Push({"name": (rs.%Get("Name")), "version": (rs.%Get("VersionString"))}) } $$$ThrowOnError(sc) return dependents

Method.name: GetLines
Method.Description: Returns the show output for module, one line per element. installedVersions maps each lowercased dependency name to its installed version, e.g. {"fslog":"1.0.3"}. requiredBy lists the installed modules that directly depend on module, e.g. [{"name":"other-app","version":"2.0.0"}].

Method.name: GetInstalledStatus
Method.Description: Returns how installedVersion relates to dependency, e.g. "installed 1.0.3", "installed 0.9.0, unsatisfied", or "not installed".

Method.name: ParseRequirements
Method.Description: Returns the trimmed requirement lines of stream, skipping blank lines and # comments. %Stream.FileCharacter reads LF and CRLF files alike on any OS.

Method.name: SplitLines
Method.Description: Returns the non-blank lines of text, each trimmed. Handles LF and CRLF line endings.

Method.name: GetSection
Method.Description: Returns the section key for resource in the sections object of GetLines, or "" when show leaves it out. Classifies by the resolved processor class alone and never instantiates the processor.

Method.name: GetShortName
Method.Description: Returns processorClass without the default processor package, or unchanged when it is outside that package.

Method.name: GetWebApplicationDetail
Method.Description: Returns what serves the web application: its dispatch class, WSGI app, or physical directory, or "" for none.

Method.name: GetAttribute
Method.Description: Returns the first non-empty attribute among names, or "".

Method.name: GetRequirements
Method.Description: Returns the lines of requirements.txt under root, or none when the file is absent.

Method.name: Join
GetSystemRequirements
AddList
Method.Description: Appends heading and entries to block, or nothing when there are no entries.

Method.name: AddTable
Method.Description: Appends heading and rows to block, or nothing when there are no rows. Each row is a [left, right] pair, where right may be "". Left columns of rows with a right side are padded to a common width.

Method.name: AddBlock
Method.Description: Appends a blank line and then block to lines, or nothing when block is empty.
